components.name: Stage Tab
components.description: A numbered square tab that labels each stage of the archive workflow.
components.css: .ds-stage-tab { display: flex; width: fit-content; min-height: 30px; margin: 0; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding-right: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--blue); color: var(--blue-dark); font-family: "Cascadia Code", Consolas, monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-stage-tab span { display: inline-grid; width: 32px; align-self: stretch; place-items: center; background: var(--blue); color: white; }

components.name: File Aperture
components.description: A ruled-paper drop target for selecting or replacing a local Moodle archive.
components.html: Arrastra aquí una copia .mbzGZIP TAR, ZIP o TAR · máximo 768 MB
components.css: .ds-file-aperture { display: grid; min-height: 230px; padding: 30px; place-items: center; align-content: center; gap: 16px; border: 1px dashed var(--line-dark); background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 31px, rgb(21 87 214 / 11%) 32px, transparent 33px), linear-gradient(var(--paper) 31px, rgb(21 35 58 / 7%) 32px) 0 0 / 100% 32px; color: var(--ink); text-align: center; transition: border-color 160ms ease, background-color 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease; } .ds-file-aperture.ds-is-dragging { border-color: var(--blue); background-color: #eaf0fb; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-file-aperture.ds-has-file { border-style: solid; } .ds-file-glyph { display: grid; width: 58px; height: 58px; place-items: center; background: var(--ink); color: var(--white); box-shadow: 6px 8px 14px rgb(244 201 86 / 55%); } .ds-file-aperture strong { display: block; font-family: "Newsreader", Georgia, serif; font-size: 20px; } .ds-file-aperture small { color: var(--ink-muted); font: 12px "Segoe UI", sans-serif; }

components.name: Version Selector
components.description: A contiguous three-cell target ledger with cobalt selection and an amber inspection mark.
components.css: .ds-version-selector { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); border: 1px solid var(--line-dark); } .ds-version-selector label { position: relative; display: grid; min-height: 96px; padding: 16px 12px; align-content: end; border-right: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--white); color: var(--ink); cursor: pointer; } .ds-version-selector label:last-child { border-right: 0; } .ds-version-selector label:has(input:focus-visible) { outline: 3px solid var(--amber); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-version-selector input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; } .ds-version-selector .ds-selected { background: var(--blue); color: white; box-shadow: inset 0 5px 0 var(--amber); } .ds-version-selector span { font-size: 9px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-version-selector strong { font-family: "Newsreader", Georgia, serif; font-size: 28px; line-height: 1; } .ds-version-selector small { position: absolute; top: 10px; right: 9px; padding: 2px 5px; background: var(--amber); color: var(--ink); font-size: 8px; font-weight: 900; }

components.name: Primary Conversion Button
components.description: The consequential conversion action, enabled only after compatibility blockers are resolved.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: flex; width: 100%; min-height: 54px; padding: 0 18px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; border: 0; background: var(--blue); color: white; font-family: "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 800; box-shadow: 4px 7px 16px rgb(21 35 58 / 28%); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--blue-dark); transform: translate(-1px, -1px); box-shadow: 6px 10px 20px rgb(21 35 58 / 32%); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--amber); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: #a9afba; box-shadow: none; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Decision Checkbox
components.description: A bordered approval row used when conversion requires explicit consent to data loss.
components.css: .ds-check-row { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 26px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 12px; min-height: 68px; padding: 14px; align-items: start; border: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--ink); font-family: "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-check-row:hover { border-color: var(--blue); } .ds-check-row:has(input:focus-visible) { outline: 3px solid var(--amber); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-check-row input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; } .ds-check-control { display: grid; width: 24px; height: 24px; place-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--blue); background: var(--blue); color: white; } .ds-check-row strong, .ds-check-row small { display: block; } .ds-check-row strong { font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.35; } .ds-check-row small { margin-top: 5px; color: var(--ink-muted); font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.4; }

components.name: Verdict Stamp
components.description: A slightly rotated inspection stamp that reports whether conversion decisions remain.
components.html: 1 bloqueo
components.css: .ds-verdict { display: flex; width: fit-content; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; align-items: center; gap: 9px; border: 2px solid currentColor; font-family: "Cascadia Code", Consolas, monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; transform: rotate(-1deg); } .ds-verdict.ds-blocked { color: #a93620; }

components.name: Manifest Strip
components.description: An ink-filled ledger summarizing the archive facts that frame the inspection decision.
components.css: .ds-manifest { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.2fr 1.2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr; margin: 0; border: 1px solid var(--line-dark); background: var(--ink); color: white; } .ds-manifest div { padding: 14px 17px; border-right: 1px solid #526077; } .ds-manifest div:last-child { border-right: 0; } .ds-manifest dt { color: #9eacbd; font-family: "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .13em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-manifest dd { margin: 4px 0 0; font-family: "Cascadia Code", Consolas, monospace; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; white-space: nowrap; } @media (max-width: 600px) { .ds-manifest { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); } .ds-manifest div:nth-child(2n) { border-right: 0; } .ds-manifest div:last-child { grid-column: 1 / -1; } }

components.name: Completion Drawer
components.description: The prepared-archive state, combining a green seal with primary and report downloads.
components.html:
La conversión está lista.

Descarga la copia y conserva el informe junto a ella.
components.css: .ds-completion { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 70px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 24px; padding: 28px; align-items: center; border: 2px solid var(--green); background: #eff9f3; color: var(--ink); box-shadow: 8px 12px 28px rgb(31 122 87 / 20%); } .ds-completion-seal { display: grid; width: 64px; height: 64px; place-items: center; border: 3px double var(--green); border-radius: 50%; color: var(--green); transform: rotate(-7deg); } .ds-completion h3 { margin: 0; font-family: "Newsreader", Georgia, serif; font-size: 30px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.05; } .ds-completion p { margin: 8px 0 0; color: var(--ink-muted); font: 13px/1.55 "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-completion button { min-height: 50px; padding: 0 15px; border: 0; background: var(--green); color: white; font-weight: 800; cursor: pointer; } .ds-completion button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--amber); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
MoodlIA Backup Converter feels like a working conservation table for a fragile technical archive. Warm ruled paper, deep institutional ink, square folder tabs, and evidence marks turn the workflow into an inspection record rather than a generic upload wizard. The atmosphere is calm, exacting, and materially grounded.

The interface is dense enough to support consequential decisions but never dashboard-like. It moves from opening a backup, through compatibility evidence and explicit approval of loss, to an auditable download. Color and elevation are deliberately scarce so that selection, risk, and completion retain their meaning.
keyCharacteristics: Warm archive paper with a subtle 32px ruled baseline.
Deep ink masthead and data strips that frame the work as an official record.
Cobalt actions and selected states, with amber accents that mark inspected choices.
Orange and red reserved for inspection, progress, blockers, and destructive risk.
Square sheets, tabs, controls, and borders; only status dots and completion seals are round.
Editorial serif headlines paired with pragmatic sans-serif copy and monospaced evidence.

rules.name: The Cobalt Is Consent Rule
rules.body: Use cobalt for selection, navigation through the workflow, and user-authorized action; do not use it as ambient decoration.

rules.name: The Inspection Mark Rule
rules.body: Orange, amber, and blocker red behave like annotations on a record: compact, high-signal, and tied to review or risk.

rules.name: The Evidence Has a Separate Voice Rule
rules.body: Use monospaced type only for machine state, indices, archive facts, and procedural labels—not for ordinary explanatory prose.

rules.name: The Serif Carries Meaning Rule
rules.body: Newsreader belongs to the page thesis, milestone headings, file names, and version numerals; it should not spread into controls or dense findings copy.

rules.name: The Shared Baseline Rule
rules.body: In split work areas, align the primary action across the complete sheet rather than attaching separate actions to each panel.

rules.name: The Paper First, Lift Second Rule
rules.body: Establish hierarchy with surface tone and borders before adding shadow; ordinary choices, findings, notes, and ledgers stay unraised.

rules.name: The Square Sheet Rule
rules.body: Keep operational surfaces rectilinear. Do not soften the conservation-desk character with generic rounded cards or pill controls.

dos: Do use warm paper, deep ink, and visible ledger rules to preserve the archive-conservation setting.
Do reserve cobalt for deliberate action, selection, stage indexing, and active progress.
Do show compatibility evidence before presenting destructive approval or conversion as available.
Do use Newsreader for consequential editorial headings and Cascadia Code for evidence and machine state.
Do keep keyboard focus visibly amber and preserve the reduced-motion and forced-colors accommodations.
Do let desktop split panes collapse into a clear document sequence below 880px.
donts: Don't introduce rounded dashboard cards, pill selectors, gradient hero panels, or soft SaaS-style controls.
Don't use orange, amber, red, or green as broad decorative fills; they are inspection and outcome signals.
Don't add shadows to routine rows, findings, labels, or target cells; borders and paper tones already establish their hierarchy.
Don't turn the workflow into a generic multi-step wizard or hide consequential evidence behind progressive disclosure.
Don't use monospaced text for normal prose or Newsreader for dense operational controls.
Don't add shipping raster imagery without recording its provenance; the current system ships no raster assets.
